basics.founded: 2013 as a university (began in 1998 as Dehradun Institute of Technology)
basics.type: Private state university under the DIT University Act (Uttarakhand Act No. 10 of 2012)
basics.other: Programmes in engineering, architecture, pharmacy, management, sciences, design, liberal arts and nursing

placements.source: NIRF 2025 engineering data submitted by DIT University

admission: Class 12 with Physics and Mathematics (55–60% aggregate depending on branch)
Merit counselling on JEE Main rank, merit counselling on Class 12 marks, or direct admission for board toppers (10% of seats)
As per Council of Architecture rules
Merit in Class 12; CUET scores count for scholarships

scholarships.text: First-year merit scholarships on tuition: 100% for 95% and above in Class 12 (PCM/relevant subjects) or a JEE rank up to 50,000; 50% for 90–95% or JEE rank 50,001–80,000; 25% for 80–90% or JEE rank 80,001–1,00,000. There is also a 25% tuition scholarship for students from Uttarakhand and Himalayan states.

hostel.text: On-campus accommodation and transport; fees are listed on the university's hostel and transport fee page.

fees.text: For 2026-27, first-year fee for B.Tech CSE is ₹3,82,600 (two instalments of ₹1,91,300), before scholarships. Uttarakhand and Himalayan state students pay ₹3,22,826 after the 25% state scholarship.
